title: Find the name of the tallest player born before 1986 who has a potential sc
question: Find the name of the tallest player born before 1986 who has a potential score equal to the highest potential among players weighing more than the global average weight.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE SUBSTRING(p.XCL_125, 1, 4) < '1986'
  AND pa.XCL_133 = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.XCL_133)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    JOIN Player p2 ON pa2.XCL_130 = p2.XCL_122
    WHERE p2.XCL_127 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_127) FROM Player)
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC
LIMIT 1
